trace.content:
You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: Specialist QA Engineer
Company: Absa Group
About the company: With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.
Purpose of the role: Design automation testing plans and develop automation test scripts for multiple technical products / services (pre, during & post deployment) in both ‘Run & Change’ contexts and align to chosen application testing frameworks & guidelines. Testing may apply to all or a combination of the following front-end, back-end, integration, performance, scalability and regression testing of solutions. This entails full responsibility for ensuring products are protected through quantifiable test coverage & metrics.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Proactively contribute & participate in the full solution development lifecycle as a member of a squad / multiple squads as an QA automation specialist engineer
  - Actively participate in daily Scrum and project planning meetings.
  - Participate and analyze test automation requirements during the requirements analysis phase of technical product & service development, maintenance & optimization (across tribes & squads) – using design specifications and technical documentation (e.g. Business Briefs, User Stories, Architecture & Integration documentation)
  - Prepare QA & Automation testing documentation (planning, design, execution and sustainability)
  - Develop automation test plans
  - Develop and execute automated test scripts using various technologies (automated scripts, test harnesses, SQL scripts etc.)
  - Perform various types of automation testing (regression, integration, black box, scalability)
  - Evaluate automated test cases and analyse & report results
  - Facilitate test plan / case reviews within squads
  - Work with product engineers to evaluate software / solution quality & provide recommendations for improvement / enhancement
  - Contribute to the design and selection of testing frameworks for business applications
  - Deliver all automation & technical testing deliverables on time (always)
  - Provide the required project / scrum related information / feedback on deliverables (e.g. progress, tracking, quality etc.)
  - Conduct performance monitoring on applications / components of applications for which you’ve designed and executed test scripts / plans
  - Produce quality and testing outcome metrics and reports
  - Follow engineering best practices and continuously improve on engineering knowledge to successfully shift our QA capability forward
  - Leverage coding language understanding & expertise to deploy testing requirements for specific products / services
  - Understand the full technical solution that is being tested – show interest and capability to run the technical solution & the ability to test the viability of the code being developed
  - Shift from testing features to supporting & being accountable for full product delivery
  - Ensure compliance with technical risk and governance requirements
  - Ensure work is compliant with automation testing frameworks and standards
  - Proactively identify and communicate risks ahead of need
  - Participate in Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, Incident Management processes as required and implement mitigating actions
  - Participate in peer reviews & continuously develop automation testing awareness & capability across squads
Must-have requirements:
  - Bachelor's Degree: Information Technology
Location: Johannesburg
Employment equity statement: Absa is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from suitably qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds. In support of our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) commitments and Employment Equity objectives, preference may be given to candidates from underrepresented designated groups, including persons with disabilities.
Accessibility statement: We encourage applicants who may require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process to let us know so that appropriate support can be provided.
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

Specialist QA Automation Engineer

Absa Group

Johannesburg

About us
With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.

About the role
You will design automation testing plans and build automation test scripts for multiple technical products and services, before, during and after deployment. You will work in both 'Run' and 'Change' contexts and align to the chosen application testing frameworks and guidelines. Testing may cover front-end, back-end, integration, performance, scalability and regression testing. You take full responsibility for protecting products through quantifiable test coverage and metrics.

Your team
You work as part of a squad or across multiple squads, alongside product engineers.

What you'll do
• Contribute to the full solution development lifecycle as the QA automation specialist in one or more squads
• Attend daily Scrum sessions and project planning meetings
• Analyse test automation requirements from design specifications and technical documentation, including business briefs, user stories and architecture and integration documents
• Prepare QA and automation testing documentation covering planning, design, execution and sustainability
• Develop automation test plans for technical products and services
• Build and run automated test scripts using technologies such as automated scripts, test harnesses and SQL scripts
• Perform regression, integration, black box and scalability testing
• Evaluate automated test cases, analyse results and report on them
• Facilitate test plan and test case reviews within squads
• Work with product engineers to assess solution quality and recommend improvements
• Contribute to the design and selection of testing frameworks for business applications
• Deliver all automation and technical testing deliverables on time
• Report project and Scrum information such as progress, tracking and quality
• Monitor the performance of applications and components you have written test scripts and plans for
• Produce quality and testing outcome metrics and reports
• Deploy testing requirements for specific products using your coding knowledge
• Understand and run the full technical solution under test, and test the viability of the code being developed
• Move from testing features to being accountable for full product delivery
• Meet technical risk and governance requirements, and keep work compliant with automation testing frameworks and standards
• Identify and communicate risks ahead of need
• Take part in Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery and Incident Management processes and implement mitigating actions
• Take part in peer reviews and build automation testing capability across squads

What you need
• Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology
• Ability to write and run automated test scripts using technologies such as test harnesses and SQL scripts
• Working knowledge of a coding language, needed to deploy testing requirements and assess the code under test
• Experience with regression, integration, black box and scalability testing
• Experience working in a squad using Scrum ceremonies such as daily stand-ups and planning

Nice to have
• Experience contributing to the selection and design of testing frameworks
• Experience with performance monitoring of applications
• Experience producing quality and testing outcome metrics and reports

We encourage applicants who may require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process to let us know so that appropriate support can be provided.

Absa is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from suitably qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds. In support of our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) commitments and Employment Equity objectives, preference may be given to candidates from underrepresented designated groups, including persons with disabilities.
